purpose: Define OSC as an optional address/message adapter to explicitly bound canonical controls, events or data operations with schema/type validation.

topics.name: OSC Adapter
topics.purpose: Define OSC as an optional address/message adapter to explicitly bound canonical controls, events or data operations with schema/type validation.

semantics.address_rule: OSC address maps explicitly to canonical target/operation identity.
semantics.argument_rule: OSC arguments validate against declared target schema/types.
semantics.transport_rule: UDP/TCP or other supported transport binding is explicit where applicable.
semantics.state_rule: Listener runtime state is separate from OSC mapping definition.
semantics.authority_rule: Receiving a syntactically valid OSC message does not imply authorization.
semantics.mapping_rule: Wildcard/dynamic mappings, if supported, are explicitly bounded and cannot escape declared namespace.

invariants.rule: Protocols expose or transport canonical operations/data but never become semantic owner or bypass canonical authority.

hard_gates.condition: OSC address fuzzy-resolves arbitrary canonical target

references.purpose: OSC mappings resolve explicit canonical addresses.
